items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Topsy' only in the context of it being a hit song and a movie title, with no personal interaction or professional relationship described between Cozy Cole and a person named Topsy.

ctx.x: No, not really because, I don't know, there's a boy, John, Bill Pete, he's a drummer with Jack Teagarden. But he didn't become well known because Jack wasn't featuring drums. He was with Jack Teagarden for a while. Then we had quite a few drummers around there gigging that never got big names.
Between you and having 'Topsy' and I guess the movie of Gene's life came out in the late '50s.
